d:
Actor Dia Mirza's video appealing to people to celebrate an eco-friendly Diwali has sparked a political controversy in Mumbai. The video was part of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's pollution-free Diwali campaign amid concerns over rising air pollution.
Mumbai BJP chief Ameet Satam objected to Dia Mirza's participation, saying people do not need lessons on how to celebrate Diwali.
Following his objection, the BMC removed the video from its social media platforms, while videos featuring Madhuri Dixit and cricketer Ajinkya Rahane remained available.
